description: core's quest lifecycle corpus (conformance/quests/lifecycle.json, P3.core) through the quest.lifecycle.* rows, each session the calls core's reference runner (src/quests/quest-corpus.ts) makes, through them: create, then one apply per step; numbers held exactly (the corpus's tolerance is 1e-9; tests/quests_lifecycle_corpus.cpp replays the file itself within it).

cases.name: quests-lifecycle: the contract quest.lifecycle.contract states
quests-lifecycle session: seed talk_one: a conversation held before the accept does not count
quests-lifecycle session: seed talk_one_in_order: accept, talk to someone else, then the target
quests-lifecycle session: seed chain_two: an available follow-up is not opened by its prerequisite; it still needs an accept
quests-lifecycle session: seed availability_rule: a reach matches the location name
quests-lifecycle session: seed full_quest5: collect counts each pick-up against the item count

quests-lifecycle session: completedAtMs: a completion stamps its step's atMs; a quest still active carries none, even after a step with a time; a completion by a step with no atMs stamps nothing

quests-lifecycle session: completedAtMs: a chained completion stamps its own step's time: the quest a completion activates, and the one it makes available (then accepted), each carry the time of the later step that completed them; the first keeps its own
quests-lifecycle session: completedAtMs: a quest a step activates and completes carries that step's time, and every quest one pick_up stack completes carries the stack's time

quests-lifecycle session: completedAtMs: a quest that opens completed keeps its input's whole-ms time; a fraction, a negative number or a string is no time; an active quest's input time is dropped, and 0 is a time

quests-lifecycle session: refusals: atMs present and not a whole number of ms from 0 (a fraction, negative, a string, null, a boolean) is bad_time and changes nothing; it is checked after every other check of the step
